verses.2: And ye are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you.
verses.3: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that hath so done this deed,
verses.4: In the name of our Lord
verses.5: To deliver such an one unto
verses.6: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?
verses.7: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even
verses.8: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
verses.9: I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators:
verses.10: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must ye needs go out of the world.
verses.11: But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.
verses.12: For what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do not ye judge them that are within?
verses.13: But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.
